currentTitleSettings.siteDescription: Check detailed Rocket League Stats and Leaderboards rankings.

appPromo.title: TRN In-Game App
appPromo.description: Get our in-game real-time tracking solution for your Rocket League stats to make sure you are on top of the competition. Just download, install, and start playing and we'll take care of the rest. Player Overviews, Play Performance, and Live Match Rosters!

items.label: Leaderboards
items.description: See how you stack up against the best in the world

items.label: Live Tracker
items.description: Track your sessions and see your progress as you play, start a new session at any time or add players to compare with teammates and opponents

items.label: Favorites
items.description: Compare your friends, teammates and opponents by their skill rating in each of the Rocket League playlists

items.label: Distribution
items.description: Find out the percentage of players by tier in the latest season and learn the true value of your skill

items.label: OBS Overlay
items.description: Show off your stats on your stream
